# Fish Length Analysis

Analysis fish length data from Gaeta et al.

### Set-Up

Load in the `tidyverse` package and the fish scale length data.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
fish_data <- read_csv("data_raw/Gaeta_etal_CLC_data.csv")
```

Look at the dataset
```{r}
glimpse(fish_data)
```

Calculate the minimum and maximum scale length data in each lake.
```{r}
fish_data %>% 
  group_by(lakeid) %>% 
  summarize(min_scale_length = min(scalelength, na.rm = T),
            max_scale_length = max(scalelength, na.rm = T))
```
